experiment: interference curve - does filling reserved slots degrade recall of earlier context
setup: 4 fixed history facts; NS slots each filled with a sub-agent answer; questions asked one at a time

curve.slots: 4/8 (rerun n=8; first run 0/3 was small-n noise)

conclusions: history recall is exactly flat (12/12) from NS=0 to NS=8: filling slots does not displace earlier context
slot retrieval is 50-75% with a single appended question, but 12/12 (NS=3) and 20/20 (NS=5) with the Q-label format
question format matters more than slot count for slot retrieval
